source_refs.note: Elastic limit: a main subheading of 5.5 Elastic deformation, plastic deformation and elastic limit, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 98-98.

blocks.text: Agar O aur B ke beech kisi bhi point par load hata diya jaye to curve usi raste wapas aata hai aur material apni asal lambai par aa jata hai. Hissa OB mein material elastic hai. Point B ko yield point kehte hain, aur B par stress ki value elastic limit σₑ kehlati hai.
